h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.zh: 北非摩洛哥、突西亞於去年第四季,各新增至少1例狂犬病死亡病例,病患均曾經犬隻咬傷,疫苗接種史不明;西亞以色列亦報告近8年來首例病例,為經犬隻咬傷,目前仍住院治療,當局已對接觸者進行預防接種;南亞印度馬哈拉什特拉邦新增至少1例死亡病例,病患曾被流浪犬貓咬傷,因無傷口而未接種疫苗。
h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.en: In North Africa, Morocco and Tunisia each reported at least one new rabies death in the fourth quarter of last year. All patients had been bitten by dogs, and their vaccination history is unknown. In West Asia, Israel reported its first case in nearly eight years, a person bitten by a dog, who is still hospitalised; authorities have given post-exposure vaccination to contacts. In South Asia, Maharashtra State in India reported at least one new death; the patient had been bitten by a stray dog or cat and, because there was no wound, had not been vaccinated.
